g.text: Endpoint architecture comparison | frozen image encoder

g.text: UJ: distinct block parameters; SJ: shared block | terminal-only supervision | connecting segments compare different fitted models
Observed tune: 159 Cases (51 malignant, 108 benign). Five paired seeds; Case-to-patient mapping unverified; no clinical validation.
Only refiners/heads are trained; common image encoder frozen (5,717,416 parameters). No augmentation; final update 3,200 fixed.
Trainable parameters: UJ2 1,159,394; UJ4 2,049,122; SJ2/SJ4 714,530. Matched updates do not equal parameters or FLOPs.
Untied blocks start at shared initial values but own independent parameter storage; this is a controlled refiner contrast.
Means are not ensembles; variability is sample SD across fitted seeds, not confidence intervals. Cross-model errors are not internal corrections.
